faqs.q: What are Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes used for?
faqs.a: U-tubes bent from seamless chrome-moly ASTM A213 T-grade and A209 tube, for high-temperature exchangers and feedwater heaters, to your bend schedule. It is listed in 12 sizes, 15.88–25.4 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes, such as IH-TF-UA-AL-0159-124?
faqs.a: Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes part numbers begin with IH-TF-UA-AL and then give the outside diameter in tenths of a millimetre and the wall thickness in hundredths of a millimetre. IH-TF-UA-AL-0159-124 is 15.88 mm outside diameter by 1.24 mm wall, and IH-TF-UA-AL-0254-277 is the largest size listed. Quote the full part number, or the standard, grade, OD and wall.

faqs.q: What sizes do Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes come in?
faqs.a: Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes are listed in 12 sizes, 15.88–25.4 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-UA-AL-0159-124 and IH-TF-UA-AL-0254-277. The table includes 15.88 mm OD by 1.24 mm wall and 25.40 mm OD by 2.77 mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity, with the bend schedule. Centreline radius and leg length for each row, and any heat treatment of the bends. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: How tight can the bends be on Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes?
faqs.a: The bend radius for Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes: 1.5×OD centreline radius available; dimensional tolerances guaranteed from 2×OD.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes?
faqs.a: For Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes, testing follows the governing standard: Straight-tube tests per A213/A1016. Mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes available in?
faqs.a: Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes are available in these grades: A213 T11; A213 T22; A209 T1; A209 T1a. If your site needs a particular material grade, coating or material certificate, say so on the enquiry and we confirm it before the order.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes?
faqs.a: Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes are made to ASTM A213 / SA-213, ASTM A209, ASTM A1016, DIN 17175 (superseded by EN 10216-2), EN 10216-2. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes, U-tubes go into the tube sheet of a removable-bundle exchanger at both ends and are held by baffles or support plates, so the bend schedule must match the bundle layout. Related ranges are the [Carbon Steel U-Bend Tubes](/c/carbon-steel-u-bend-tubes) and [Copper-Alloy U-Bend Tubes](/c/copper-alloy-u-bend-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

faqs.q: How are Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes shipped, and can they be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We ship Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Do you keep Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, Alloy Steel U-Bend Tubes are held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the sizes and quantities you need through [our contact page](/contact).
